name: Library
description: A private-first Android storefront for developer-signed GitHub releases. Library verifies the exact APK bytes, package identity, version code, and signing certificate before handing an install to Android.
changelog: GitHub Release discovery with APK metadata and signing-certificate pinning.
Private-repository support using a device-local GitHub token protected by Android Keystore.
Signed release CI that publishes installable APKs and a rolling catalog release.
Native PackageInstaller updates with package, version, hash, and signer verification.
